taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Kor-road (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1916 | 1.24 | 1.24
2 | 1252 | 1.79 | 3.03
3 | 1658 | 108 | 111
4 | 581 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as HK-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Kor-road (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: HK
Aquifer depth: 3.03 – 111 m (Layer 3, 1658 Ω·m)
Recommendation: Target the resistive Layer 3 as the main aquifer zone, drilling to approximately 111 m depth with casing through the shallow overburden (0–3.03 m); install well screens within the 3.03–111 m interval and confirm the lower boundary with drill cuttings since Layer 4 (581 Ω·m) likely represents a lower-resistivity clayey/shaly unit acting as a confining base.
